When the fight starts I execute the frame perfect Instant Veraero (also known as IV in the community) by spamming my 4 Key and Tab while moving forward at the same time. Really happy with this time I doubt it will be beaten by any other red mage any time soon unless a new strat is discovered like Instant Verthunder or something like that.
